summary: Virax Biolabs Group Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-25 reverse share split approved by the board and shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting on June 12, 2026, effective June 26, 2026. The consolidation aims to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule. No fractional shares are issued; fractions are rounded up. The par value adjusts from $0.001 to $0.025 per share. The action is a routine corporate housekeeping measure to maintain listing and does not involve a special situation like a restructuring, going-private, or capital return. There are no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb aspects.
